lines.text: Here's something that should be simple.
lines.say: Here's something that should be simple.

lines.text: You've got USDC on an exchange. You want it in a savings app on Arc.
lines.say: You've got U-S-D-C on an exchange. You want it in a savings app on Arc.

lines.text: So you send it… and the app has no idea it's yours.
lines.say: So you send it... and the app has no idea it's yours.

lines.text: Exchanges and wallets can only send to an address.
lines.say: Exchanges and wallets can only send to an address.

lines.text: But apps keep money in smart contracts, and those only accept it through their own deposit function. That's how they know who to credit.
lines.say: But apps keep money in smart contracts, and those only accept it through their own deposit function. That's how they know who to credit.

lines.text: Sending is easy. Getting it into the right contract is the hard part.
lines.say: Sending is easy. Getting it into the right contract, that's the hard part.

lines.text: Doorstep closes that gap.
lines.say: Doorstep closes that gap.

lines.text: It turns an ordinary USDC transfer into a proper deposit, credited to the right person.
lines.say: It turns an ordinary U-S-D-C transfer into a proper deposit, credited to the right person.

lines.text: Here's how.
lines.say: Here's how.

lines.text: First, the app sets the instructions: the contract, who gets credited, and where refunds go.
lines.say: First, the app sets the instructions. The contract, who gets credited, and where refunds go.

lines.text: Those instructions produce an address. Change anything, and you get a different one.
lines.say: Those instructions produce an address. Change anything, and you get a different one.

lines.text: The payer just sends their USDC there, from a wallet or straight from an exchange.
lines.say: The payer just sends their U-S-D-C there, from a wallet, or straight from an exchange.

lines.text: Then a delivery bot calls the contract's deposit function for them. If it can't, the money goes back to the refund wallet.
lines.say: Then a delivery bot calls the contract's deposit function for them. If it can't, the money goes back to the refund wallet.

lines.text: And it's live on Arc mainnet.
lines.say: And it's live, on Arc main-net.

lines.text: In the demo, you get your own savings address, with a QR code and the instructions behind it.
lines.say: In the demo, you get your own savings address, with a QR code, and the instructions behind it.

lines.text: Send a few cents, and watch it arrive in your savings.
lines.say: Send a few cents, and watch it arrive in your savings.

lines.text: Every payment gets a receipt, and Doorstep's cut is zero.
lines.say: Every payment gets a receipt. And Doorstep's cut, is zero.

lines.text: Behind it: an SDK on npm, a hosted API with signed webhooks, and a bot that runs around the clock.
lines.say: Behind it, there's an S-D-K on N-P-M, a hosted A-P-I with signed webhooks, and a bot that runs around the clock.

lines.text: Arc is what makes this practical, because gas is paid in USDC.
lines.say: Arc is what makes this practical, because gas is paid in U-S-D-C.

lines.text: The bot spends USDC to deliver, and it's repaid in USDC from the payment, with a cap.
lines.say: The bot spends U-S-D-C to deliver, and it's repaid in U-S-D-C from the payment, with a cap.

lines.text: No second token. No price oracle. No swaps.
lines.say: No second token. No price oracle. No swaps.

lines.text: Apart from that capped fee, money only goes two places: into the contract in the instructions, or back to the refund wallet.
lines.say: Apart from that capped fee, money only goes two places. Into the contract in the instructions, or back to the refund wallet.

lines.text: Nobody can redirect a payment, and there's no admin key at all.
lines.say: Nobody can redirect a payment, and there's no admin key at all.

lines.text: It isn't audited yet, so keep the amounts small.
lines.say: It isn't audited yet, so keep the amounts small.

lines.text: And because it's just an address, any app can use it.
lines.say: And because it's just an address, any app can use it.

lines.text: Savings. Escrow. Invoices. Payroll.
lines.say: Savings. Escrow. Invoices. Payroll.

lines.text: Even AI agents: our MCP server lets them create, check and deliver payments, but never send money anywhere else.
lines.say: Even A-I agents. Our M-C-P server lets them create, check, and deliver payments. But never send money anywhere else.

lines.text: Your users' money is already out there.
lines.say: Your users' money is already out there.

lines.text: Doorstep gives it a way in.
lines.say: Doorstep gives it a way in.
